formulation: Residual-weighted axisymmetric thermal transport, including integrated P2 advection and cylindrical P1 diffusion
model: Fixed-property transformer, laminar buoyancy, unchanged geometry and physical bounds

diagnosis.pressure_policy: Pressure increments do not enter the velocity step limit; original momentum and continuity equations determine line-search acceptance.
diagnosis.window_initialization: Identical verified initial fields for each subdivision in one window
diagnosis.selection: Lowest total diagnostic cost among procedures meeting unchanged equation and balance criteria in the declared windows; failed attempts remain included. If no procedure qualifies, diagnose before extending the campaign.

resolution.spatial_test: Nested mesh refinement with unchanged physical geometry, material labels, time history and exact P1 control transfer
resolution.stop_rule: Two nonimproving refinements trigger diagnosis rather than relaxed tolerances or indefinite refinement.

temperature_margin.exceeds_cap: Refine further; do not clip the computed margin.
temperature_margin.scope: Optimization bounds tighten inward; independent assessments use the unchanged physical bounds. The empirical margin is not a rigorous error certificate.

optimization_order: Reoptimize target 7 on the verified formulation and discretization, assess its frozen source on finer grids, then targets 8 and 15.

performance_after_accuracy_gates.policy: Freeze the rank policy after a declared pilot; matched starts, accuracy, hardware and physical bounds; rotate solver order; charge all work and report every outcome.

restart: Atomic fields and hash-bound records after every returned Newton and fallback attempt and every completed time step. Resumed runs remain separate from uninterrupted timings.
publication_gate: Keep prescribed-flow results unchanged. Add a coupled stationary-point claim only after the forward-resolution, feasibility, optimization and matched complete-cost gates pass.
